pre_publish_fixes_2026_09_04.human_required: The Career Path fact-review and Language in-context QA loops do not appear to be converging to a clean PASS through further autonomous iteration (6 and 4 rounds respectively, each with real fixes but new findings every round) — the same class of issue as the existing 'Codex reviewer calibration' precedent (factory memory: codex-reviewer-calibration.md). A human decision is needed on: (a) what residual risk is acceptable to publish with real, sourced (if imperfect) career-path data plus a visible disclaimer, vs. requiring live web re-verification of the remaining flagged professions before publish, and (b) whether to invest in a full systemic furigana pass across all 63 Q1 components before publish, or ship with the current partial-but-substantially-improved coverage plus a visible 'if you can't read a word, ask an adult' affordance. Stopped here per this session's max-iteration policy rather than looping indefinitely.
